content: Yesus po saumane raunanto vatano anawayo kakaije siso aije ai
Umba Yesusa pe apa arakove nawe wo onae Galilea raotar unanta no vatano Gerasa awa munije rai.
Yesus no no nyomane rai umba paje, naije vatano no no tinda aipapo inta de Ai. Vatano napije pamo anawayo kakaije siso ai,
ti nove no aipapo rai. Sopamo bambunin dave, weti vatane inta wo aokaisyo waijo besije rai kakai, weye awa vambunine mamaisye ramu.

Susye manui rave vatane wo aneme ajoe raokokaisyo waijo besi rai to, weramu seo po rapatimuve tutir. Muno po aitamu besijo ajoe rausiso rai radaut tavon. Opamo bambunin dave ti vatane wo aijare kakai.
Namane rinit vatane umaso no no aipapo muno puje to no no pukam, umba tamije gwagwaimbe muno po orame veano anasine ratuturi ti mbe pabe anyi.
No gwaravaimbe po Yesus aeno dei, umba pansanan bayave re po apa vukane ranteter no Amun.

Umba Yesus po raura nanto ai pare, “Anawayo kakai, nyuje vatane so aora!” Naije vatane umaso gwain akoeve rave pare, “Yesus, Arikainyo Amisyo no no munijo ntiti, Nyo rinave tai ruimaisye so? Syo Amisye apa tame rauranara Nyo inansewabe inya.”
Umba Yesus po anajo pare, “Nya tame mi rui?” Vatane umawe po raura pare, “Sya tame mirati Legiun, weye reamanui rave.”
Muno anawayo kakaije umaso wo Yesus anajo kewabe tutir indamu vemo Po mawatan wuje uta nggwaravain nora.
Mararai jirati unarijoe rai, ugeye wanui rave wo anaisye rakanive no unate ama awananeme warea.
Anawayo kakaije umaso wo raura nanto Yesus ai ware, “Reamayar dai mi so: reamare Nyo reansatutir sisa wana no ugeye wato mai.”

Umba Yesus po mansamayar kobe, weti anawayo kakaije wuje kobe umba uta sisa ugeye mai. Uge umawe wansansanan udadoyaro pene rai ti utaoponasyo no onae waraya, weti usayadi kobe. Awa manuije mirati ribuge jirum.

Vatano wo ugeye makum unaji damu wakata umanine ramu, yara wo ana nande uge mai raura kakavimbe vatano munijo we mai muno munijo we ama varodore raita tenambe. Weti vatano munijo we nao wakare wo raen.
Ude Yesus ai, umba wo vatano anawayo kakaije wuje aije umawe aen. Wakoe! Wepamo tuna Yesus atavon, po apa ansune rave, muno apa ana po ratantona ngkov akato. Weti vatano munije umawe ujani dave.
Umba vatano nanawirati wo raeno mamije raije wo ana nande vatano napije pe uge nawe mai raura kakavimbe mai.
Umba vatano wanui umaso wo Yesus anajo indamu puje irati awa munije raora.
Weti Yesus seo no nyoman, umba vatano anawayo kakai wuje ai umawe po Yesus anajo indamu tavondi Ai.
Weramu Yesus ponae, pare, “Vemo wintavondi Rinai nora. Yara nyakato ra nyo saumano Amisye po raunande naije raura vatane mai, muno nyo Amisye apa muinyo Po rarorono naije raura mai tavon.”
Weti vatane umawe poroto kobe, siso puje Munije Abusyin
raita tenambe, po saumano Yesus po raunande anasine raije ravovo no ratuije. Weti vatane unantaive tenambe.
Yesus po saumane raunanto Yairus apa kavo wanya me, wanya rantukamo Apa ansune raije me yai
Yesus seo nyomane rai jakato, Po onae raotar pakanande no onae tuga rani, umba vatano wanuije ude wo akiani no onae tuga rai.
Umba vatane inta de, apa tame mi Yairus. Opamo akarijo yavaro sambaya inta rai. Arono po Yesus aen, de po vukane ranteter no Amun.

Umba po Yesus anajo memembe pare, “Injae, sya kavo wanya nggwanen akoeve rave, kavinta ratire ngkakai. Ti syare winde, indamu Nyo naneme raunanto ntamijo rai, indamu vemo ngkakai jinya, yara ranakea nsauman.”
Weti Yesus tavondijo Yairus ai, umba vatano wanui utavondi wo Yesus arijat, ti wo akikipi no awa yasyin.
Awa yasyine umaso wanya nggwanen inta, omamo nanto waneno embae rai tutira tume abusyinara eane rurun to.
Omamo mo anawae wanui mapan to indamu wo saumane raunanto rai, muno ama ananuge mpatimugo mansai, weramu mbea marudi. Ranakea nsaumane jewen, yara ama yorame manakoe iridi.

Wanya so mo Yesus anaumbe to ti mo ratantona mare, “Syantukamo Apa ansune rai vayave indati risauman aje.” Weti wanya umaso no no vatano wanuije awa yasyin umba mararaijo Yesus akirije rai, umbawe rantukamo Apa ansune rai.
Umba kavuratawe ama mavu muje umawe nsopi kobe ti mo raen ranakea nsauman to.
Naije kobe Yesus nanto rai pare Apa vambunine inta muje no anasine rai to. Weti sarirae Po vatano wanui umaso manajo pare, “Are nyirati nantukamo Sya ansune raije so?”
Apa arakovo utavondi aije wo raura ware, “Injae, taune Winyi nyo vatano wanuije so maen unande ti wo nakikipi kiani, weti Nyo manajo are nawirati wantukamo Nya ansune raijo e?”
Weramu Yesus po vatane maen kiani indamu Po vatano mansantukamo Aijoe maen.

Wanya umawe mo ranakea raen nsauman to, weti mo Yesus asyani ti ranakea ntutar. Umba nde mo vukane ranteter no Amun, umba mo raura kakavimbe mare, “Risyi syantukamo Nai to,” umba mo ama ana nande rai umawe raura kakavimbe tenambe Ai.

Umba Yesus po raura nanto wanya umaso rai pare, “Wanya arikainyo winy, nyanave Rinai jivae, wirati winsaumanoe. Soamo nya yorame rapaya nai to, weti nyoronto kai, syare Amisye apa kovo saumane no nautan.”
Arono naije Yesus payaowa nene, umba vatano una no Yairus apa yavar inta ude ware, “Injayo Yairus, nya kavo ngkakai to, ti vemo winyakaore nyo Injayo Kurune ansosobe nora.”
Yesus po awa ayao umaso ranaun weramu ponayo rai, weti Po raura nanto Yairus ai pare, “Vemo njani nora, yara nyanave vayave.”
Umba Po vatano wanui umawe mansamayaro utavondi Aije ramu, yara Petrusa pe Yakobusa pe apa rijato Yohanesa pe obo nao utavondi.
Arono ude no Yairus apa yavar, Yesus po vatane maen woyovo arikainye umawe rai weye ngkakai to.
Umba siso no yavare umaso rai, Po raura mansai pare, “Wabeanimaibe wapoyov? Arikainye wato mamo ngkakaije ramu, yara ta nikija.”

Weramu vatane umaso wugoeno Ai. Weti Po vatano wanui umaso mawatan ti wuje. Umba Po apa arakovo utavondi aije umawe nawe, arikainye umawe ama aja pe akoya me obo mauga ti usisa no tanoan uma wanya arikainye ntami rijoe rai.
Umba Yesus po arikainye umaso raneme raijar, Po raura aje rai pare, “Talita kum,” ama ine mare, “Arikainyo winy, syare winseo!”
Naije kobe arikainyo kamurame umawe nseo, muno manya mananave. (Ama tume abusyinara eane rurun to.) Muno vatano wo raen onawamo unantaive rave anapaporainye umaso rai.
Weramu Yesus po maorai pare, “Wabemo wapo ana umaso raura vatane inta mai nora!” Muno Po matutir indamu wo anaisye raunanto arikainye umaso rai indamu mo raisy.

footnotes.text: Raura ayao Yunani raijamo Dekapolis, ama ine mare munije abusyin.
